LanguageData.TurboTick_Prototype: Hosting and joining both connect to a dedicated server first. Once the server grants the host role, select or create a colony and publish it for everyone.
LanguageData.TurboTick_EnableDesc: In a room, enabled state, multiplier and cap require server confirmation together. Single-player preferences stay local.
LanguageData.TurboTick_ShowHudDesc: Players, latency, synchronization status and TPS. Click the header to collapse the list.
LanguageData.TurboTick_Held: Connection pending / lost: simulation held. Reconnect or leave the room in settings.
LanguageData.TurboTick_RoomPrototype: Connected to the room. Waiting for the host to share a colony.
LanguageData.TurboTick_Local: Not in a room / local mode
LanguageData.TurboTick_LowTps: Below target TPS. Adjust the speed through the user or server.
LanguageData.TurboTick_StartShared: Publish current colony and start sharing
LanguageData.TurboTick_Enable: Enable extra multiplier (on by default, synced per room)
LanguageData.TurboTick_AutoRecoverDesc: Reconnect and catch up from the server checkpoint when divergence is detected. Off shows a notice only.
LanguageData.TurboTick_PauseOnDesync: Pause and ask on a desync
LanguageData.TurboTick_PauseOnDesyncDesc: Pause the timeline and show a dialog when divergence is detected, so you decide whether to reload the checkpoint. Off applies the setting above immediately.
LanguageData.TurboTick_DesyncBody: State at tick {0} differs from another player (fields: {1}).\n\nReloading rewinds to the server checkpoint and loses everything since; staying means the two sides drift further apart.
LanguageData.TurboTick_ExperimentalDesc: Replicates loading items into transport pods. Not verified in game; off by default.
LanguageData.TurboTick_EveryoneTrades: Allow everyone to trade and form caravans (unsynced)
LanguageData.TurboTick_EveryoneTradesDesc: By default only the host can trade or send out a caravan, keeping silver, goods and colonists consistent. Enabling this lets each player act locally, which can diverge.
LanguageData.TurboTick_NativeControls: In a room, the game's native pause, normal, fast and superfast buttons and key bindings synchronize by default. One player selects; all peers apply after server confirmation. Single-player keeps vanilla speeds.
LanguageData.TurboTick_LobbySubtitle: Build one colony together. Join your friends' world at any time.
LanguageData.TurboTick_LobbyFooter: TurboTick · RimWorld 1.7 · Native time controls synchronize for everyone
LanguageData.TurboTick_CurrentColonyDesc: Share the colony you are playing with friends.
LanguageData.TurboTick_NewColonyDesc: Choose a scenario, world and colonists, then publish to the dedicated server.
LanguageData.TurboTick_SearchSaves: Type a save name to filter
LanguageData.TurboTick_NoSaves: No matching saves. You can create a new colony.
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostGuide:
1. Enter the running dedicated server's address, port and your player name.

2. Connect and obtain the host role, then select a save or create a colony.

3. Publish the loaded/generated colony to that same server.

Other players join this server. It runs independently of the host's computer.
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostSaveGuide: The dedicated server has granted you the host role.\n\nSelect a save or create a colony, then publish it to this server for everyone to load.
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostConnectFirst: Use Host game to connect to the dedicated server and obtain the host role first.
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostConnectionLost: The connection or host role changed. Save publication has stopped; reconnect to the server.
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostRoleReady: The server confirmed your host role. Select a save or create a colony.
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostOccupied: This server already has a host. Use Join game to enter.
LanguageData.TurboTick_ConnectionFailed: Dedicated server connection did not complete: {0}
LanguageData.TurboTick_ServerWorldContinues: The server already has a shared colony. Continuing its saved world.
LanguageData.TurboTick_JoinGuide:
1. Get the dedicated server's address and port from the host.

2. Use the same game version, mods and configuration.

3. Join to download the save and catch up automatically.

Colored pointers and names show other players on the same map. Use the native pause and speed buttons.
LanguageData.TurboTick_WaitForHost: Connected. Waiting for the host to share a colony; the save will load automatically.
LanguageData.TurboTick_InvalidName: Enter a player name with 1 to 32 printable characters.
LanguageData.TurboTick_ChooseSave: Select a saved colony or create a new one.
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostCreating: Complete the native new-colony setup to host automatically.
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostLoading: Loading the selected colony, then hosting automatically.
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostConnecting: Connecting to the dedicated server and requesting the host role...
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostPublishing: Publishing the shared save. The game will open automatically...
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostReady: Your room is ready. Friends can join now.
LanguageData.TurboTick_HostPatchesMissing: Required synchronization patches are not ready. Check diagnostics.
LanguageData.TurboTick_ShowPlayerCursorsDesc: Display colored pointers and names on the same map, independently of the multiplayer panel.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminGuide: Use the server administration password to check its status or archive and restart. This remains available when the normal connection fails because game versions or mods differ.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminCredentialsChanged: Authenticate this server. The password stays in this window only and is cleared when you close it.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminUnauthenticated: Enter the address, port and administration password, then authenticate to view the server status and restart its colony.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminConnecting: Authenticating password and reading server status...
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminAuthenticated: Administration password accepted. Let all players know before restarting.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminConfirmReset:
Archive and restart server {0}?

The old colony will be archived and every online player will be disconnected. The server will use your currently enabled game version, DLC and mod combination.

This client will return to the main-menu multiplayer lobby. Save any local single-player progress you want to keep first. You will reconnect and request the host role, then choose a saved colony or create a new one.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminResetting: Checking current game content, archiving and restarting. Please wait...
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminResetComplete: Server archived and restarted. Once the host role is granted, choose a saved colony or create a new one.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminManifestFailed: Could not read the current game and mod information. Check the active mod configuration and retry.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminCancelled: The room connection changed and this administration operation was cancelled. Authenticate the intended server again.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminRateLimited: Too many administration authentication attempts. Wait a moment, then authenticate again.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminDisabled: Password administration is not enabled on this server. Ask its maintainer to set an administration password, then retry.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminAuthenticationFailed: The administration password is incorrect. Check it and authenticate again.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminUnsupported: This server version does not support this management window yet. Ask its maintainer to update the server, then retry.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminTimeout: The server response timed out. Authenticate and refresh its status to check the archive result before retrying.
LanguageData.TurboTick_AdminConnectionFailed: The administration connection was interrupted or did not complete. Check the address, port and server, then retry. Older servers may need an update.
LanguageData.TurboTick_RoomDisconnectedGuide: You are not connected to this room. Reconnect, or use Manage server above to check and restart the server.
LanguageData.TurboTick_RoomConnecting: Connecting to the dedicated server. Please wait...
